name: my-app-tracker
description: 期效管家 - 極簡物品生命週期與保固管家

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('index.html','www/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('app.js','www/app.js'); if (fs.existsSync('style.css')) fs.copyFileSync('style.css','www/style.css'); if (fs.existsSync('mobileclip2-labels.js')) fs.copyFileSync('mobileclip2-labels.js','www/mobileclip2-labels.js'); if (fs.existsSync('mobileclip2-labels.json')) fs.copyFileSync('mobileclip2-labels.json','www/mobileclip2-labels.json');"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
